title: Mid-Run Disconnect Leaves Recoverable Host State
description: The laptop drops its MCP connection while a slow smoke preflight is still running on the host. After the host daemon restarts on the same data directory, the task must still be recoverable: the persisted state is readable, the worktree is reattached, preflight can finish, and approval plus execution still produce exactly one evidence record.

injected_fault.detail: Slow the smoke path so the client connection can be killed mid-preflight

user_prompt: My laptop lost the connection while the host was preflighting. Is the task lost or can we continue?
forbidden_hallucinations: claiming the task was lost after the disconnect
fabricating a completed run without a recovered evidence node

ground_truth_assertions.description: SQLite still reports the task as running preflight after a hard daemon kill
A restarted daemon reattaches the worktree and completes the smoke preflight
The post-reconnect approval executes once and records one fresh evidence node
